run1_recheck.note: Same steps, 18 tries in all. A (R + Backspace on Results, level_03): 5 of 5 end on ['Outcome'] only, built once. B (Enter + Backspace at the end of the level_03 chat): 5 of 5 end on one screen; at worst Results is built and then Backspace on it goes back to Chat, which is two inputs and two actions with one screen at a time. C (Try again + Levels on a fail Outcome, level_01): 5 of 5 go to ['Results'] only; the first click wins. Find a place + Levels clicked together in the chat: 3 of 3 end on one screen. Two map buttons clicked together (Options + Friends) open only Options. goScene() in src/ui/sceneSwitch.js now guards every scene change.

With both clicks in the same frame: Recommend this on level_01 builds Outcome once (3 of 3) and the Liam card shows. The LEVEL 1 card double-click builds Chat once and the CHAPTER 1 card shows (2 of 2). Next level → double-click from level_05 builds Chat once and the CHAPTER 2 card shows. Map buttons Options, Credits, Friends, Scrapbook and Title, plus Find a place, Back to chat, Levels and level_20 Continue, are each built once on a double-click.

Leaving the level_01 Outcome 150, 300 or 800 ms after Recommend (Next level →) no longer marks Liam and Cyrus as announced, and replaying level_01 shows their card (3 of 3). Mashing Enter x4 on Results still goes Results > Outcome > level_02 chat in about 1.5 s, but the friends stay unannounced. One way to lose the card remains, with Esc; see SC-05.

Double-clicking the LEVEL 1 card at 60, 120 and 200 ms leaves the CHAPTER 1 card up (3 of 3), and chapter-intros is not stored until the card is closed. Enter+Enter, Enter+Esc, Enter+Space and Enter x5 from the map also leave the chapter card up.

bugs.title: Esc closes a 'new friend' card while it is still popping in, before the name and portrait show, and the friend is marked announced for good
bugs.where: Outcome, any level that introduces friends (seen on level_05 and level_01); the code takes the same path for 'NEW SCRAPBOOK PAGE!' cards
steps: New save. Open ?scene=Outcome&level=level_05&venue=campus_basil_hearth (or reach it normally by recommending Basil Hearth)
As soon as the 'A NEW FRIEND HAS JOINED!' card starts to appear (about 1.4 s in), press Esc once. Or mash Esc 3 times, 40 or 150 ms apart
Open the same Outcome again, or any later Outcome
bugs.expected: Like Enter, → and the buttons, Esc waits until the card has finished popping in (unlockCard.ready), or at least until the friend's name is shown, before it closes the card. A friend counts as met only after the player could see them.
bugs.actual: Esc closes the card while it is still faded and empty: no portrait, and the name has alpha 0. The friend still goes into lets-eat-friends-announced-v1, because announceShown runs when the card is created. One Esc loses Maya; three quick presses lose Maya, Mina and Brooke. Their cards never come back (revisit shows 0 cards). Cause: the Outcome's ESC handler calls showNextUnlock() whenever unlockCard is set and never checks unlockCard.ready, while Enter, → and the buttons do check it (OutcomeScene.js, onKey 'ESC'). A carried-over or mashed Esc easily lands in this window, because the hint line says 'esc: close recap or card'.
bugs.frequency: every time (4 of 4: Esc x1, Esc x3 at 40 ms twice, Esc x3 at 150 ms; also in the Esc x10 mash in run2_8)

not_bugs: Every scene change is now guarded (goScene): no two-screen state could be produced by any pair of keys or clicks tried.
Map O then Esc within ms: Options opens, then the Esc closes it back to the map. That is two inputs and two actions, one screen at a time.
Results: filtering out the open place with F closes its details, so R then does nothing. Sorting keeps the focus ring on the same place.
Results: with place A open, clicking place B and Recommend in the same instant recommends B, the last place chosen. That is consistent with the clicks, not a stale pick.
Friends ↓ x12 at 15 ms moves one friend, and Scrapbook → x12 turns about two pages: input is ignored while a turn animates (by design, as in run 1).
Options Reset progress: R + Enter x3 together opens the confirm and leaves it up. The Enters do nothing until its buttons are ready, so progress is safe.
On the volume panel, Enter and Space toggle the music. A mash with an odd number of them leaves music off, as pressed.
Ending: Esc x10 from the start skips both parts, then the remaining Esc presses walk Map > Title. ending-seen is set on leaving. Replaying level_20 after the ending shows only Back to levels.
level_20 Continue double-clicked while an unlock card is still up does nothing; the card blocks it. Without cards, it opens the Ending once.
?scene=Outcome&level=level_09&venue=x (a made-up venue id) gives no scene and 1 page error. This is a misuse of the dev shortcut, not a player route, so it is not reported.
feedback: Much sturdier than run 1. I could not get two screens at once or lose a chapter card any more; the only impatient-player trap left is Esc on the pop-in of a new friend card, which skips the friend for good.
